feature.name: Return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control

notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 23.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Cast Reanimate by paying 2 life.
returning Chainer onto the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel, scrying 1.

notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 13 life.
description:
Cast Spellseeker, stacking Inalla's trigger under Spellseeker's ETB trigger.
Tutor Culling the Weak to hand with Spellseeker's ability.
Cast Culling the Weak, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve and pay for the Inalla trigger from earlier, creating a token copy of Spellseeker and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
When the token ETBs, tutor Unearth to your hand.
Unearth Spellseeker, leaving {B}{B} floating.
Shortcut resolving both Inalla's trigger and Spellseeker's ETB, tutoring for Burnt Offering and Finale of Promise, leaving {B} floating.
Cast Burnt Offering, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{R}{R}.
Use that mana to cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Unearth and Culling the Weak.
Sacrifice a Spellseeker token to Culling the Weak for {B}{B}{B}{B} and Unearth Spellseeker.
Resolve Spellseeker's ETB and Inalla's trigger, tutoring Entomb and Reanimate into hand.
Entomb and then Reanimate Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Resolve Archaeomancer's ETB, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering on Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from when Archaeomancer ETB'd and return Reanimate to your hand, leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Reanimate Archaeomancer and resolve the Inalla trigger, retrieving Burnt Offering and FInale of promise, {B} floating.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {R}{R}{B}{B}.
Cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Entomb and Reanimate.
Entomb Shallow Grave and Reanimate Archaeomancer, {B} floating.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, making a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Return Shallow Grave with the token copy's ETB.
Cast Shallow Grave targeting Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Repeat steps 20-24 for infinite hasty Archaeomancers.

easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 7 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, gaining 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Reanimate, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's last ability any number of times, dealing infinite damage.
notes: The minimum life you need to start this combo is reduced depending on how many spells you have cast this turn.

Repeat until each opponent with a lower life total than your own has lost the game.

notablePrerequisites: There are three or more creatures in your graveyard.
description:
Cast the prepared copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, unpreparing Grave Researcher.
When you cast this, Spellweaver Helix triggers, allowing you to cast a copy of the Extra Turn Sorcery, causing you to gain an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the copy of Reanimate, returning Children of Korlis from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 1 life.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, gaining 1 life.
At the beginning of your extra turn's upkeep, Grave Researcher triggers, allowing you to surveil 1 and prepare it.
Repeat.
